classes.name: Healthy
classes.line: No sign of rust, leaf miner or leaf spot.
classes.answers_json_en: These leaves look healthy. No sign of rust, leaf miner or leaf spot was seen. This check covers leaves only, not berries.

classes.name: Leaf rust
classes.line: Rust shows as yellow-orange powder under the leaf.
classes.answers_json_en: This looks like coffee leaf rust. Rust shows as yellow-orange powder under the leaf. The extension officer makes the final call.

classes.name: Leaf miner
classes.line: Dry brown patches on the leaf.
classes.answers_json_en: This looks like leaf miner damage. It shows as dry brown patches on the leaf. The extension officer makes the final call.

classes.name: Brown eye spot (Cercospora)
classes.line: Round brown spots with a pale centre.
classes.answers_json_en: This looks like brown eye spot. It shows as round brown spots with a pale centre. The extension officer makes the final call.

classes.name: Phoma
classes.line: Dark patches, often on young leaves after cold weather.
classes.answers_json_en: This looks like Phoma leaf spot. It shows as dark patches, often on young leaves after cold weather. The extension officer makes the final call.
